title: Taiwan detects 4 PLA aircraft, 6 naval vessels; 2 cross median line
detail: Taiwan MND figures for the 24 hours to 6 a.m. Nov 8: 4 PLA aircraft, 6 PLAN vessels and 2 official ships; 2 aircraft crossed the median line into the southwestern ADIZ. Activity is sharply lower than the Nov 3-4 peaks. Single-outlet relay of MND data (ANI/WebIndia), so unconfirmed.

media.caption: Taiwan detects 4 PLA aircraft, 6 PLAN vessels operating near territory
